name: Table
description: A data table in a rounded frame with sortable columns, row selection and a sticky header.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the table for assistive technology.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Height past which the body scrolls under a sticky header.

props.name: density
props.description: Row padding of 12 or 8 pixels.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: Adds a checkbox column. Multiple selection gets a select-all box in the header.

props.name: selectedKeys
props.description: The ids of the selected rows (controlled). Use defaultSelectedKeys when uncontrolled.

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Called when the selection changes.

props.name: sortDescriptor
props.description: The column the rows are sorted by. Sort the data yourself in onSortChange.

props.name: onSortChange
props.description: Called when a sortable column is pressed.

props.name: onRowAction
props.description: Called when a row is activated.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the outer frame.

props.name: tableClassName
props.description: Extra classes for the table element. Every other prop goes to the react-aria-components Table.

props.name: id
props.description: Identifies the column in sortDescriptor.

props.name: allowsSorting
props.description: Pressing the heading sorts by this column; an arrow shows the direction.

props.name: isRowHeader
props.description: Marks the column that names each row. Set it on one column.

props.name: children
props.description: The heading.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components Column, such as width.

props.name: children
props.description: Column elements, or a function of each item in columns.

props.name: columns
props.description: Column data for a dynamic header.

props.name: items
props.description: Row data for a dynamic body; render each with children.

props.name: children
props.description: Row elements, or a function of each item.

props.name: renderEmptyState
props.description: Shown when there are no rows. Defaults to "No results".

props.name: id
props.description: Identifies the row in the selection.

props.name: children
props.description: Cell elements, one per column.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: The row cannot be selected or activated.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components Row.

props.name: children
props.description: The cell's content.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components Cell.
